comparisons.INPUT_CONTRACT: Observed account/partition/QoS evidence; explicit output path
comparisons.OUTPUT_CONTRACT: Non-scientific generated SLURM script validated before atomic publication
comparisons.ERROR_HANDLING: Donor templates write directly; V2 rejects ambiguous/unsafe associations and invalid rendering
comparisons.EXIT_CODE_HANDLING: V2 checks bash and embedded-validator exit codes
comparisons.PATTERN_REUSED: Separate render step and human-inspectable scheduler artifact
comparisons.PATTERN_REJECTED: QE commands, fixed cluster resources, direct unvalidated writes and submission helpers
comparisons.ADAPTATION_REQUIRED: Safe association grammar, temporary file, static validators and no submission
comparisons.FINAL_DECISION: Rewritten for the M3R evidence-only contract

comparisons.INPUT_CONTRACT: Numeric job ID and stub/real scheduler observations
comparisons.OUTPUT_CONTRACT: Versioned raw stdout/stderr/exit codes plus conservative summary.json
comparisons.ERROR_HANDLING: V2 preserves command failures and never infers success from queue absence
comparisons.EXIT_CODE_HANDLING: squeue and sacct codes are recorded separately
comparisons.STDOUT_STDERR_CAPTURE: Dedicated timestamped files for both commands
comparisons.VALIDATION_STRATEGY: Exact main-job row, explicit terminal set and review for unknown state
comparisons.PATTERN_REUSED: None from the unsafe empty-squeue completion inference
comparisons.PATTERN_REJECTED: Treating disappearance from squeue as completion and QE workflow advancement

comparisons.ERROR_HANDLING: Fail closed with category and file detail
comparisons.STDOUT_STDERR_CAPTURE: Compiler and parser diagnostics are captured
comparisons.VALIDATION_STRATEGY: Checksums, manifest, structure, secrets, path safety and multi-language syntax
comparisons.PATTERN_REJECTED: QE input semantics and scientific defaults
comparisons.ADAPTATION_REQUIRED: Package/runtime validation rather than QE validation
comparisons.FINAL_DECISION: Generic validation lifecycle retained after refactor

comparisons.INPUT_CONTRACT: Read-only login environment and command availability
comparisons.OUTPUT_CONTRACT: Raw bounded observations plus login summary
comparisons.ERROR_HANDLING: Optional commands record exit codes; supported commands use bounded execution when timeout exists
comparisons.EXIT_CODE_HANDLING: Recorded per optional probe, never silently converted to verified
comparisons.STDOUT_STDERR_CAPTURE: Login stdout/stderr and per-command combined evidence
comparisons.VALIDATION_STRATEGY: Observed association must be unique before scheduler rendering
comparisons.PATTERN_REJECTED: Automatic cluster recommendation and cluster-specific fallbacks
comparisons.FINAL_DECISION: Discovery separation retained; policy logic removed

comparisons.OUTPUT_CONTRACT: Verification evidence followed by controlled bundle collection
comparisons.ERROR_HANDLING: Reject traversal and propagate verifier/collector failure
comparisons.STDOUT_STDERR_CAPTURE: Upstream probe logs are included; collector diagnostics remain visible
comparisons.PATTERN_REJECTED: QE output harvesting and scientific field extraction

comparisons.INPUT_CONTRACT: Complete local evidence tree and optional controlled timestamp
comparisons.OUTPUT_CONTRACT: Normalized tar.gz with manifest and checksums
comparisons.ERROR_HANDLING: Blocks missing evidence, symlinks, traversal and overwrite
comparisons.EXIT_CODE_HANDLING: Nonzero exit on every incomplete/unsafe condition
comparisons.STDOUT_STDERR_CAPTURE: Requires and normalizes both scheduler channels
comparisons.VALIDATION_STRATEGY: Required paths, safe resolution, deterministic tar metadata and checksum coverage
comparisons.PATTERN_REJECTED: QE inputs, pseudo download guidance and direct overwrite behavior
comparisons.ADAPTATION_REQUIRED: Reproducible evidence bundle with zero scientific content
comparisons.FINAL_DECISION: Artifact-kit pattern retained after security refactor

comparisons.INPUT_CONTRACT: Optional read-only command plus evidence output path
comparisons.OUTPUT_CONTRACT: Bounded output and explicit exit-code sidecar
comparisons.ERROR_HANDLING: Timeout where available, no shell eval and no swallowed status
comparisons.EXIT_CODE_HANDLING: Recorded even when the workflow continues
comparisons.VALIDATION_STRATEGY: Executed by the stubbed login-probe integration test
comparisons.PATTERN_REUSED: Bounded subprocess, explicit code and captured diagnostics
comparisons.PATTERN_REJECTED: Automatic sbatch retries and shell=True option
comparisons.ADAPTATION_REQUIRED: POSIX-shell implementation without runtime donor dependency

comparisons.OUTPUT_CONTRACT: Compile-only diagnostics with file and source lines
comparisons.ERROR_HANDLING: Nonzero for syntax, decoding or unterminated heredoc
comparisons.VALIDATION_STRATEGY: Extract every PY heredoc and call compile without execution
comparisons.FINAL_DECISION: Implemented locally; donor has no equivalent
